acceptance_met: scripts/perf-profile.sh captures cpu (samply|perf|sample), syscalls (strace -c|dtruss -c with privilege probe), rusage (python3 wait4: voluntary/involuntary ctx switches, max RSS, faults) and heap (massif|macOS heap snapshots + RSS series); any requested capture without a usable tool exits 3 with 'tool missing' and writes no summary.

provenance.json records git SHA + dirty flag, rustc/cargo/python versions, full argv, allowlisted workload env knobs, CPU model, OS and per-capture tool versions; CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=true is exported for every capture run without otherwise changing codegen.
One run directory holds provenance, per-capture artifacts, summary.json and validating checksums.sha256; docs/benchmark.md gained a Profiling section linking the script, and profiles/ is git-ignored.
commands: bash scripts/perf-profile.sh --self-test (PASS: detection report, per-capture ok-or-fail-closed, rusage end-to-end shape + checksum validation, bad-input rejection)
Full default run against release bench_produce fails closed as designed: exit 3 'tool missing: syscalls requires one of: strace, privileged dtruss', no summary.json written

bench_produce validation capture: KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=127.0.0.1:19092 COUNT=2000000 WARMUP_SECS=0 --only cpu,rusage,heap vs isolated nullbroker: 3x2000000 acked, summary.json + 13 companion artifacts, 14/14 checksums OK
limits: Unprivileged macOS has no syscall tracer (dtruss needs dtrace privileges): full 4-capture runs fail closed there; use --only cpu,rusage,heap and read the summary manifest for what ran.

No folded stacks from Apple sample output (prefix-compressed tree format): cpu artifact is raw samples; flamegraph.svg renders only on the Linux perf path when stackcollapse+flamegraph.pl are installed, or natively from samply output.

Each capture re-runs the workload once (no tracer stacking); numbers across captures are separate repetitions, and the heap run is slower (snapshot overhead: 770k vs 1.3-1.6M rec/s here). Linux perf/strace/massif paths are written to standard usage but unexercised on this macOS host.

test_names: --self-test: detection + fail-closed matrix + e2e shape + checksums + input rejection
